name: Scorm field
description: Provides a SCORM package field type, widget and player: content editors upload a SCORM ZIP to a node field, the module extracts and parses the imsmanifest.xml, and renders an iframe-based SCORM 1.2 / 2004 player that tracks CMI/score/completion data per learner.

suggests.drupal/x_frame_options_configuration: Recommended by the README for decoupled mode so the backend can be embedded as an iframe on a different front-end domain.
suggests.drupal/rest: Required to expose the module's @RestResource plugins (access-token, create-attempt, report, scorm-data, start-sco endpoints).

project_description: Scorm field adds a SCORM e-learning field to Drupal entities (nodes). It defines a 'Scorm field' field type (extending core FileItem, ZIP upload) whose ItemList postSave unzips the uploaded package into public://scorm_field_extracted/scorm_<fid>, parses imsmanifest.xml (SCOs, resources, sequencing objectives, metadata) into the scorm_field_scorm_packages / _package_scos / _package_sco_attributes tables, and renders a themed iframe player (SCORM 1.2 and 2004) via the 'Scorm player' formatter. A JavaScript SCORM runtime (js/lib/api-1.2.js, api-2004.js, player.js) drives the SCO iframe and commits CMI data back through module routes; per-learner CMI data is stored in scorm_field_scorm_cmi_data and pass/fail/score reports are kept as scorm_report config-independent records, integrated with the attempt_mgmt module for attempt handling. A decoupled mode (site settings + REST resources + a token table) lets a headless front-end embed the player by requesting a one-time access token and iframe URL. Ships Views for reports (scorm_attempts, scorm_report_per_node), per-node-type iframe sizing settings, and a 'reset scorm data' permission.
